library.description: Runtime-neutral sync, async middleware and generator chain executors.

blocks.text: English
`@migaia/middleware-pipeline` 把校验、转换和前后收尾拆成可复用步骤，用明确的继续、短路与取消规则按顺序执行。

items: 异步任务没结束，计时和收尾已经完成：手写回调链没有把下游 Promise 交回外层等待。
复用同步步骤后，next 后面的代码顺序变了：为了接入异步流程，改写时混淆了“提交值”和“立即执行下游”。
请求已取消，下一步仍开始执行：复用的流水线只检查应用默认信号，没有采用本次请求的信号。
校验拒绝了值，保存步骤仍然运行：生成器返回了业务值，没有明确选择整链短路。
清空缓存时，终点回调却没有执行：生成器把普通 undefined 返回当成了结束，而不是要交付的空值。
外层可以等待并包裹整个下游。 手写回调容易在异步结束前收尾；async 模式的 next 返回下游原 Promise，计时示例把收尾留到终点之后。
同步步骤提升后仍保持同步顺序。 直接改成异步回调可能改变 next 后面的代码时序；lift 保留“先返回、再下游”的规则，复用示例展示了这个顺序。
每次运行可以选择自己的取消边界。 只看应用默认信号会遗漏请求取消；run 的 `control.signal` 覆盖默认值并传给步骤，取消示例阻止了终点回调。
生成器可以明确停止整条链。 把校验失败的值继续返回会让保存照常执行；`GENERATOR_HALT` 是独立控制符，短路示例没有执行保存或终点。
空值与结束有不同含义。 普通 return undefined 会停止生成器链；`GENERATOR_UNDEFINED` 明确交付 undefined，空值示例的终点仍收到空值。

blocks.text: 用 Node 24 直接运行。输入 2 先加 1，再乘 2；终点回调收到 6。next 是当前步骤把新值交给后续步骤的函数。
输出：

blocks.code: 结果: 6

下面仅展示，不运行。它手写同一组数值转换，但没有区分同步继续时序，也没有限制 next 只能调用一次。
上一节默认 single 的 sync 模式只提交第一次 next 的值，当前步骤正常返回后才执行下游。重复或迟到的 next 会交给 `onViolation`，默认不重新执行下游；需要记录这些错误调用时显式提供回调。

blocks.text: 一个步骤需要拆分输入时，选择 `next: 'multiple'`。sync 在 stage 正常返回后遍历全部登记值，最后按顺序汇总失败；async 每次 next 返回独立遍历的 Promise，调用方的 `then` 或 `await` 表示观察，未观察的失败仍让 run 拒绝。生成器用 `throw()` 把下游失败交回 yield，可捕获后继续；异步生成器等待同一协议。runner 始终等待全部已启动遍历。
默认仍是 `next: 'single'`：重复 next 属于违约，生成器采用终值。完整规则及可运行示例见四模式与失败处理。

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/middleware-pipeline

blocks.text: 只有根入口；运行时仅依赖 `@migaia/utils`，无需 DOM 或 Node，包标记为 `sideEffects: false`。

rows: 固定模式、取消默认值与错误处理，返回可复用执行器。
为一次输入执行固定快照的步骤列表。
在允许方向复用已有步骤，不改原模式语义。

blocks.text: pipeline 只含只读 mode、lift 和 run，自身没有可变运行状态。每次 run 的值、索引和取消上下文隔离；stage 列表在入口复制，之后修改调用方数组不会改写当前轮。构造选项和自定义信号字段只读取一次并冻结，getter 失败以 `INVALID_OPTION` 保留原始原因。

四种模式是 sync、async、generator、async-generator。同步 next 只提交值，stage 返回后下游才开始；不调用就短路。每次获准的异步 next 立即启动下游并返回该次遍历的 Promise，即使 stage 没有 await，runner 也等待已经启动的下游。同步和 generator 同步抛错，async 和 async-generator 的 run 返回 Promise。
lift 只允许同模式、sync 到 async/generator/async-generator，以及 generator 到 async-generator；不支持 async 到 async-generator。同模式保持函数身份。被提升的 sync 步骤仍先执行完 next 后的同步代码再进入下游，抛错时不启动下游。

默认 single 下，生成器普通 return 值继续，`GENERATOR_CONTINUE` 使用最后一个 yield（没有 yield 时使用输入），`GENERATOR_HALT` 和隐式 undefined 终止，`GENERATOR_UNDEFINED` 显式以 undefined 继续且要求 `TValue` 包含 undefined。自定义三个 symbol 必须互不相同，在创建时快照，也用于 sync lift；控制符不作为业务值传到 done。公开类型的 `TSignals` 与 `TValue` 分离，默认控制集保留精确 unique symbol 类型。

run 的 `control.signal` 覆盖构造 signal；未提供时回退。只有有效信号存在时才向 stage/done 追加 context。四种模式在入口、每步开始前/返回后、done 前检查取消；生成器每次迭代后也检查。已开始的用户代码不会被强制打断。`assertActive` 复用宿主规则，入口和每步后检查；异步外层返回时即使 done 已执行也复核，但不会撤销已发生的 done。控制器和宿主仍由调用方持有。

single 下同一步重复 next 报告 duplicate；两种策略在 stage 结束后调用 next 都报告 late，默认回调为空操作。原生 Error 尽量保留类型、身份与 stack；未分类执行失败附 `EXECUTION_FAILED`，已有完整外部 source/code 不覆盖。取消 reason 使用 `ABORTED`；其他值通过 cause 保留，不保证是原生 AbortError。普通业务失败不会被之后的取消替换。

独立 stage 与 runner 负责的 downstream 失败默认聚合；multiple 中已观察的分支拒绝由 stage 负责，其余独立失败仍聚合，或交给 `combineStageAndDownstreamError`；await next 传播的同一个对象只保留一次，相等 primitive 仍可能独立。组合器自身失败时保留它和两个原错；组合器成功返回的自定义结果需要调用方履行原错可达契约。生成器取消时驱动 finally 清理；清理再次失败使用 `ABORT_CLEANUP_FAILED`，取消主错在前。

根入口公开工厂、模式、`MiddlewarePipelineNext`、生成器信号与阶段/控制/上下文类型，以及错误码和 source；具体执行器和适配器不公开。`IAbortSignal` 从 `@migaia/utils/promise` 导入；`IMiddlewarePipelineSyncMode` 只是包内中间类型，已从根入口撤回，没有兼容别名，使用 `IMiddlewarePipelineDone`/`IMiddlewarePipelineRunResult`。完整字段、模式表、提升矩阵和五个错误码（含 `MULTIPLE_DOWNSTREAM_FAILED`）见使用指南。
English
本指南先按场景提供可直接运行的代码，再列出全部模式、参数和错误语义。安装包后，每个运行示例都能单独保存为 .ts 文件，用 Node 24 运行；代码与对应网站场景一致。选用依据见 README。

sections.id: 让多个步骤依次处理同一个值
sections.heading: 让多个步骤依次处理同一个值

blocks.text: 校验、格式化步骤在多个入口被复制，某个副本又改变了执行顺序。把选定的步骤交给 `run()`，每次 `next(value)` 把处理后的值交给下一步，终点回调收到最终结果。`sync` 模式中，当前步骤返回后下游才开始。
输出：

blocks.code: 结果: 6

blocks.text: 输出 `结果: 6`：输入 2 先变成 3，再变成 6。`run()` 返回 `void`；步骤不调用 `next()` 时，后续步骤和终点回调都不会执行。

sections.id: 下游完成后再执行外层收尾
sections.heading: 下游完成后再执行外层收尾

blocks.text: 请求中的异步工作还没完成，计时器就停止了，因为手写回调链没有等待下游 Promise。`async` 模式的 `next()` 启动下游并返回它的 Promise；在 `try/finally` 中等待它，外层收尾就在下游结束后执行。这种前后包裹的执行方式称为洋葱模型。
输出：

blocks.code: 开始计时 | 校验 | 结果 6 | 结束计时

blocks.text: 输出 `开始计时 | 校验 | 结果 6 | 结束计时`。外层收尾发生在终点回调之后。这只保证执行顺序，不会撤销已经发生的副作用。

sections.id: 复用同步步骤时保留原来的顺序
sections.heading: 复用同步步骤时保留原来的顺序

blocks.text: 为了接入另一条流水线，同步规范化步骤被改写成异步回调，`next()` 后的代码却意外跑到了下游之后。`lift(stage, from)` 复用同步步骤并保留线性顺序：它的 `next()` 只记录要传递的值，当前步骤返回后下游才开始。
输出：

blocks.code:
同步步骤调用 next 前
同步步骤调用 next 后
异步步骤输入: ready
结果: READY

blocks.text: 依次输出 `同步步骤调用 next 前`、`同步步骤调用 next 后`、`异步步骤输入: ready`、`结果: READY`。同步步骤中 `next()` 后的代码仍先于下游执行。只支持文档列出的提升方向，异步洋葱步骤不能任意转成生成器步骤。

sections.id: 采用单次请求的信号-取消后不再进入下游
sections.heading: 采用单次请求的信号，取消后不再进入下游

blocks.text: 可复用流水线配置了应用信号，某次请求却需要自己的取消边界。只检查默认信号，会让已经取消的请求继续进入下一步。把 `control.signal` 传给 `run()` 来覆盖默认值；步骤在 `context.signal` 中看到同一个信号，进入下游之前会检查取消状态。
输出：

blocks.code:
采用请求信号: true
失败: 请求已取消
终点回调执行: false

blocks.text: 依次输出 `采用请求信号: true`、`失败: 请求已取消`、`终点回调执行: false`。请求信号覆盖了已经取消的默认信号，随后取消请求又阻止了终点回调。已经运行的用户代码不会被强行打断，两个控制器都由调用方持有。

sections.id: 生成器校验不通过时停止保存
sections.heading: 生成器校验不通过时停止保存

blocks.text: 生成器校验发现值不合法，却把这个值返回给下游，保存步骤仍然执行。返回 `GENERATOR_HALT` 可以明确停止整条生成器流水线，后续步骤和终点回调都不会执行。这个控制符属于生成器模式，不用于同步或异步的 `next()` 回调。
输出：

blocks.code:
写入步骤执行: false
终点回调执行: false

blocks.text: 输出 `写入步骤执行: false` 和 `终点回调执行: false`。停止控制符同时阻止了保存步骤和终点回调。配置自定义 `signals` 时，应返回它自己的 `halt` 符号，而不是这个默认常量。

sections.id: 把-undefined-交给终点-而不是意外终止
sections.heading: 把 undefined 交给终点，而不是意外终止

blocks.text: 清空缓存需要把真正的 `undefined` 作为数据交出去，生成器直接 `return undefined` 却表示停止，终点回调不会执行。`GENERATOR_UNDEFINED` 把有意交付的空值和终止分开；流水线的载荷类型必须包含 `undefined`。
输出：

blocks.code:
普通返回会完成: false
显式空值仍交付: true

blocks.text: 输出 `普通返回会完成: false`，然后是 `显式空值仍交付: true`。默认的显式空值控制符让数据被交付，控制符本身不会作为数据传出。它只用于生成器和异步生成器模式，自定义信号组使用自己的 `undefined` 符号。

sections.id: 一个步骤交出多个独立值
sections.heading: 一个步骤交出多个独立值

blocks.text: 默认 `next: 'single'` 保留单次继续规则。需要拆分一个输入时，在构造时选择 `next: 'multiple'`；该规则作用于整条 pipeline，包括 `lift()` 得到的步骤。每个交出的值各走一次剩余步骤，到达末端时各调用一次 `done`。

headers: 多次交出值与失败处理
rows: stage 正常返回后按登记顺序遍历全部值。一次失败不阻止后面的值；一个失败原样抛出，多个失败按登记顺序放入 `AggregateError.errors`。
每次 `next(value)` 立即启动独立遍历。`await` 或调用该 Promise 的 `then` 都算观察；stage 捕获并处理后可继续提交，run 不再次抛出已观察的分支错误。
每次 `yield` 完成下游后再恢复；下游失败用 `throw()` 交回该 yield，stage 可捕获并继续。
与 generator 相同，并等待下游和错误交回完成后才恢复迭代。

blocks.text: async runner 始终等待已启动的全部遍历。stage 正常结束但没有观察某个失败的 next Promise 时，run 仍以该原错误拒绝；多个未观察失败按启动顺序聚合，code 为 `MULTIPLE_DOWNSTREAM_FAILED`。`then` 表示调用方接手后续 Promise 链的错误处理；它本身不等于已经报告错误。取消和宿主活性检查仍然有效。
输出 `1,2,3 true`。第二次遍历的失败由 stage 处理，第三次仍执行。若不捕获 `await next(2)` 的拒绝，JavaScript 会直接结束这个 stage，后面的 `next(3)` 自然不会被调用。
multiple 的生成器在 `yield` 处捕获错误，例如：

输出 `1,3 true`。async-generator 使用同一规则，遍历和错误交回都被等待。未捕获时 stage 以该失败结束并执行清理。普通 `return value` 还会增加一次遍历；`GENERATOR_CONTINUE`、`GENERATOR_HALT` 或普通 `undefined` 不增加遍历，已完成的遍历不会撤销；`yield GENERATOR_UNDEFINED` 显式交出 undefined。sync 步骤提升到其他模式后，仍先正常返回，再遍历全部登记值，最后汇总失败。

sections.id: 入口-所有权与运行模型
sections.heading: 入口、所有权与运行模型

blocks.text: 只有根入口 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline`，运行时依赖为 `@migaia/utils`，不依赖 DOM、Node 或外部生命周期宿主。根入口提供 `createPipeline()`、模式与生成器信号常量、公开 stage/control/context 类型，以及错误码；具体执行器和适配器属于包内实现，不能从根入口导入。
pipeline 是执行规则固定的对象，只含只读 `mode`、`lift()` 和 `run()`。每次运行的当前值、索引、取消上下文与 `next` 状态都属于该次 `run()`；同一个 pipeline 可以复用，各次运行相互隔离。每次运行都复制一份 stage 列表，之后替换、插入或删除原数组的项，不改变本轮执行的函数列表。
stage（处理步骤）接收当前值，决定继续、短路或失败；done 是整条链成功走完后的终点回调。包不保存业务状态，不拥有取消控制器，不创建或关闭宿主。生命周期断言复用宿主已有的代次、租约或作用域规则，不在包内重建这些机制。

sections.id: 创建选项及全部默认值
sections.heading: 创建选项及全部默认值

blocks.text: `createPipeline<TValue>(options)` 必须明确选择模式。返回类型为该模式的 `IMiddlewarePipeline<TMode, TValue, TSignals>`；模式决定 stage、done、run 返回值和允许的提升方向。选项类型是 `ICreatePipelineOptions<TMode>`。

rows: `'single'` 或 `'multiple'`，对应 `MiddlewarePipelineNext`。整条 pipeline 与 lift 共用；multiple 在四种模式下都允许独立的多次遍历。
同步接收 `'duplicate'` 或 `'late'`；分别对应 `MiddlewarePipelineViolation.duplicate`、`late`。用于记录非法 next 调用，不重新执行下游。
宿主提供的同步生命周期断言。入口和每个 stage 后执行；异步模式进入下游时也会检查。抛错会阻止继续执行，包不替宿主改变状态。
默认取消信号，供未提供调用级信号的 run 使用。信号的结构和状态在 run 入口校验，不在创建时提前读取。
生成器的三个控制 symbol；字段为 `undefined`、`halt`、`continue`，必须互不相同。默认集已冻结。
把 undefined 当作显式业务值继续，而不是结束。
single 终止整条链；multiple 不增加终值遍历，也不撤销先前的 yield。
single 采用最后一次 yield 或输入；multiple 不增加终值遍历。
只用于异步洋葱执行中两个独立失败：第一个参数来自当前 stage，第二个来自它已启动的下游。返回值作为组合失败抛出；调用方要让两个原错通过 cause 或 AggregateError.errors 可达。

blocks.text: 构造选项必须是对象，不能为 null 或数组。支持的字段及自定义信号的三个属性只读取一次，再冻结内部快照；修改调用方对象不会改变已创建的 pipeline。`mode` 属性发布的就是这一份已验证值。非法模式、next 取值、回调、控制对象、信号结构、信号集或提升方向以原生 `TypeError` 和 `INVALID_OPTION` 报告。选项 getter 抛错时，原始失败保留在 `cause`。
统一调用形状为 `pipeline.run(stages, value, done, control?)`。

rows: 当前模式的只读 stage 数组；入口快照固定本轮函数身份，运行中增删留给后续调用。
调用方提供的初始业务值，之后每一步接收前一步提交的值。
每次未短路且未失败的遍历各交付一次终值。空 stage 数组直接到达 done。同步模式只能同步完成，异步模式也可返回 Promise。
默认 `undefined`。目前只包含可选 `signal`，对象不能为 null 或数组。
默认 `undefined`，回退到构造级 `signal`；提供有效信号时覆盖它，不合并两个信号。

blocks.text: 下表描述默认 single 策略；multiple 规则见独立交出多个值。

rows: stage 正常返回后；next 只提交值。
首次 next 调用立即启动下游，形成洋葱式前后包裹。

blocks.text: 默认 `next: 'single'` 时，同步 stage 最多提交一次 `next(value)`。不调用就短路，后续 stage 和 done 都不执行。它是线性转换：next 之后的同步代码仍先于下游执行；stage 抛错时不会启动下游。
异步 stage 每次获准的 `next(value)` 立即启动下游，并返回该次遍历的 Promise。因此 `await next(value)` 后的代码用于包裹式收尾。即使 stage 没有 await 已启动的 next，runner 仍等待下游结算，避免 run 提前成功。正常结束但没有调用 next 时同样短路。
`next: 'single'` 下，`duplicate` 表示在同一步结束前重复调用 next；`late` 表示该步已经返回或异步结算后才调用捕获的 next。违约不覆盖第一次提交的值，也不重启下游。默认忽略，可用 `onViolation` 记录。回调在 run 内抛错时按该模式的失败通道传播；run 结束后调用捕获的 next 引起回调抛错，会直接从那次 next 调用抛出。
默认 `next: 'single'` 时，生成器可以 yield 多次，但中间值不会逐个流向下游；只有 stage 结束后的 return 决定继续的值。

rows: 采用最后一次 yield；没有 yield 则继续用当前输入。
整条链终止，不调用 done。
同样终止，不代表显式空值。
显式以 undefined 继续；业务值类型 `TValue` 必须包含 undefined。

blocks.text: 自定义 `signals` 用自己的三个 symbol 替代默认身份，return 时要使用同一组信号。sync stage 提升到生成器时，也使用目标 pipeline 的 halt/continue，控制 symbol 不会作为普通 payload 传给 done。

`IGeneratorMiddlewareStage`、`IAsyncGeneratorMiddlewareStage`、`IMiddlewarePipeline` 和 `IMiddlewarePipelineStage` 的 `TSignals` 将控制域与 `TValue` 分开。自定义信号重载不会把 number payload 扩成 symbol。默认信号保留精确的 unique symbol 类型。
`pipeline.lift(stage, from)` 接收已有 stage 和它的来源模式 `from`，返回适合当前 pipeline 的 stage。只支持下表的无损方向；同模式返回原函数，保持 `===` 身份。
不支持 async 到 async-generator，也不支持逆向提升。类型系统会拒绝不支持的方向，运行时同样抛 `INVALID_OPTION` 的 TypeError。
提升复用包内同一套适配规则，保持调用次数、违约报告、错误和 next Promise 语义。特别是被提升的 sync stage 仍先执行完 next 后面的同步代码，再启动下游；stage 抛错时下游不启动。提升不是把原有 sync 逻辑改成异步洋葱逻辑。
可以传原生 AbortSignal，或从 `@migaia/utils/promise` 导入的结构类型 `IAbortSignal`。本包不再从根入口导出 `IAbortSignal`。有效信号需要布尔 aborted 及兼容的 addEventListener/removeEventListener 方法，可携带 reason；pipeline 读取取消检查点，不拥有控制器。
四种模式都检查 run 入口、每个 stage 开始前、每个 stage 返回后和 done 前。生成器还会在每次迭代后检查。已经开始的步骤不会被强制打断，也不会因为 signal 取消就提前放弃它正在等待的 Promise；步骤应通过收到的 `context.signal` 协作退出。
生成器在 yield 边界观察到取消时，会调用 iterator.return() 并继续排空清理期间的 yield；清理值不会送到下游。异步生成器等待这次清理完成后才拒绝。取消和清理都失败时，抛 `ABORT_CLEANUP_FAILED` 的 AggregateError，errors 依次保留取消主错与清理失败。
异步洋葱的每个外层 stage 返回时都会复核取消和宿主 active，即使 done 已经执行。检查失败不能撤销已经发生的 done。用户代码已经抛出普通失败时，该失败保持为主错误，之后的取消不会替换它。`assertActive` 的宿主控制失败不会被误当作两个独立业务失败重复组合。

异步 stage 和 runner 仍负责的下游分别失败时（multiple 仅保留未观察的分支拒绝），默认 `EXECUTION_FAILED` 的 AggregateError.errors 按 stage、downstream 顺序保留两者。若只是 await next 传播同一个对象失败，不再造两个相同错误项；相等的 primitive 仍可能是独立失败，不按值合并。

`@migaia/middleware-pipeline` runs reusable validation, transformation and surrounding work with explicit continuation, short-circuit and cancellation rules.

Outer work can await and wrap the whole downstream chain. Hand-written callbacks can clean up too early; async next returns the downstream Promise, and the timing example finalizes after the terminal callback.
Lifting preserves a sync step’s original order. Rewriting it as an async callback can move code after next; lift keeps downstream after the sync step returns, as the reuse example demonstrates.

Each run can use its own cancellation boundary. An application default alone misses request cancellation; run-level `control.signal` overrides it and reaches the stage. The cancellation example prevents the final callback.

Generators can explicitly stop the entire chain. Returning a rejected business value can still trigger saving; `GENERATOR_HALT` is a separate control signal. The short-circuit example runs neither saving nor done.

An empty value differs from ending the chain. Ordinary return undefined halts a generator; `GENERATOR_UNDEFINED` intentionally delivers undefined. The empty-value example still reaches the final callback.

blocks.text: There is one root entry. Its only runtime dependency is `@migaia/utils`; it needs neither DOM nor Node and declares `sideEffects: false`.

rows: Fixes mode, cancellation defaults and error handling in a reusable runner.
Executes a stage-list snapshot for one input.
Reuses an existing stage along a supported direction, preserving its semantics.

blocks.text: A pipeline contains only read-only mode, lift and run, with no mutable execution state. Values, indices and cancellation contexts are isolated per run. Stage arrays are copied at entry. Construction options and custom signal fields are read once and frozen; getter failures retain their original cause under `INVALID_OPTION`.

The four modes are sync, async, generator and async-generator. Sync next only commits a value; downstream begins after the stage returns, and no next means short-circuit. Each accepted async next immediately starts downstream and returns a Promise for that traversal; the runner waits even when the stage does not await it. Sync and generator throw synchronously; async and async-generator run return Promises.

Lifts allow the same mode, sync to async/generator/async-generator, and generator to async-generator. Async-to-async-generator is unsupported. Same-mode lifts preserve function identity. A lifted sync step finishes synchronous code after next before entering downstream, and a throwing step never starts downstream.

With the default single policy, generator return values continue; `GENERATOR_CONTINUE` selects the last yield or input when there was no yield. `GENERATOR_HALT` and implicit undefined halt. `GENERATOR_UNDEFINED` explicitly continues with undefined and requires `TValue` to include undefined. Three custom symbols must be distinct, are snapshotted on construction, and also control sync lifts. Control symbols do not reach done as payloads. Public `TSignals` stays separate from `TValue`; default signals retain unique-symbol types.

Run-level `control.signal` overrides construction signal, falling back when omitted. Context is appended to stage/done only when a valid signal exists. All modes check cancellation at entry, before/after stages and before done; generators also check after iterations. Started user code is not forcibly interrupted. Host `assertActive` runs at entry and after stages; returning async outer stages still recheck after done, without undoing done. Controllers and hosts belong to the caller.

Under single, duplicate next calls report duplicate; post-completion calls under either policy report late, with a no-op default handler. Native Errors keep type, identity and stack when possible; unclassified execution failures receive `EXECUTION_FAILED` and complete external source/code identities stay unchanged. Cancellation uses `ABORTED`; other reason values remain on cause and need not produce a native AbortError. Later cancellation never replaces an ordinary user failure.

Independent stage/runner-owned downstream failures are aggregated by default; in multiple mode, observed branch rejections belong to the stage. Remaining independent failures are aggregated or passed to `combineStageAndDownstreamError`. The same object propagated through await next appears only once; equal primitives can be independent failures. A throwing combiner retains itself and both originals. A successfully returned custom combination must keep both originals reachable. Generator cancellation drives finally cleanup; a second cleanup failure uses `ABORT_CLEANUP_FAILED` with abort first.

The root exports the factory, modes, `MiddlewarePipelineNext`, generator signals, public stage/control/context types, error codes and source. Executors and adapters remain internal. Import `IAbortSignal` from `@migaia/utils/promise`. `IMiddlewarePipelineSyncMode` is an internal helper withdrawn from the root without an alias; use `IMiddlewarePipelineDone`/`IMiddlewarePipelineRunResult`. See the usage guide for every option, mode and lift table, and all five error codes, including `MULTIPLE_DOWNSTREAM_FAILED`.

sections.heading: Pass a transformed value through reusable steps

blocks.text: Validation and formatting steps get copied between entry points, then one copy calls them in a different order. Pass the chosen steps to `run()`. Each `next(value)` hands the transformed value to the following step; the final callback receives the result. In `sync` mode, a step must return before downstream starts.
Output:

blocks.code: result: 6

blocks.text: Prints `result: 6`: the input 2 becomes 3, then 6. `run()` returns `void`; a step that does not call `next()` stops before later steps and the final callback.

sections.heading: Finish surrounding work after downstream completes

blocks.text: A request timer stops before the async work finishes because a callback chain returns before its downstream Promise. In `async` mode, `next()` starts downstream and returns its Promise. Await it inside `try/finally` so the outer cleanup follows downstream completion; this before-and-after nesting is the onion model.
Output:

blocks.code: start timing | validate | result 6 | finish timing

blocks.text: Prints `start timing | validate | result 6 | finish timing`. The outer finalizer runs after the final callback. This establishes ordering; it does not undo side effects that already happened.

sections.heading: Reuse a sync step without changing its ordering

blocks.text: A synchronous normalization step is rewritten as an async callback to fit another pipeline, and code after `next()` unexpectedly moves after downstream work. `lift(stage, from)` reuses the sync step with its original linear ordering: calling its `next()` records a value; downstream waits until that step returns.
Output:

blocks.code:
sync before next
sync after next
async input: ready
result: READY

blocks.text: Prints `sync before next`, `sync after next`, `async input: ready`, then `result: READY`. Code after the sync step’s `next()` still precedes downstream. Only the documented lift directions are supported; arbitrary async onion stages cannot become generator stages.

sections.heading: Use a request signal and stop before the next step

blocks.text: A reusable pipeline has an application signal, but one request needs its own cancellation boundary. Checking only the default signal lets cancelled work enter the next step. Pass `control.signal` to `run()` to override the default. Stages see that same signal in `context.signal`; cancellation is checked before entering downstream work.
Output:

blocks.code:
request signal: true
failure: request cancelled
final callback: false

blocks.text: Prints `request signal: true`, `failure: request cancelled`, then `final callback: false`. The request signal overrides an already-aborted default, and its later abort prevents the final callback. Running user code is not forcibly interrupted; the caller owns both controllers.

sections.heading: Stop a generator pipeline before a rejected value is saved

blocks.text: A generator validator detects an invalid value but accidentally returns it, so the save stage still runs. Return `GENERATOR_HALT` to stop the whole generator pipeline explicitly. Later stages and the final callback are skipped. This symbol belongs to generator modes, not sync/async `next()` callbacks.
Output:

blocks.code:
write ran: false
final callback: false

blocks.text: Prints `write ran: false` and `final callback: false`. Returning the halt symbol prevents both the save stage and final callback. A custom `signals` set uses its own `halt` symbol instead of this default constant.

sections.heading: Deliver undefined instead of accidentally halting

blocks.text: Clearing a cached value needs a real `undefined` payload, but a generator’s plain `return undefined` means stop and never reaches the final callback. `GENERATOR_UNDEFINED` distinguishes an intentional empty value from stopping. The pipeline payload type must include `undefined`.
Output:

blocks.code:
ordinary return completes: false
explicit empty value delivered: true

blocks.text: Prints `ordinary return completes: false`, then `explicit empty value delivered: true`. The default explicit-undefined symbol delivers the payload rather than becoming the payload. It is used only by generator and async-generator modes; a custom signal set supplies its own `undefined` symbol.

sections.heading: Submit several independent values from one stage

blocks.text: The default `next: 'single'` keeps the existing one-submission rule. Choose `next: 'multiple'` at construction when one input needs to produce several values. The policy applies to the whole pipeline, including lifted stages. Each submitted value traverses the remaining stages independently and calls `done` if it reaches the end.

rows: After the stage returns normally, traverse every value in registration order. One failure does not stop later values. Throw one original failure directly, or aggregate several originals in registration order.

Every `next(value)` starts an independent traversal immediately. Awaiting its Promise or calling its `then` counts as observation. A stage can catch and handle a rejection, then submit another value; run does not rethrow an observed branch error.
Finish each yielded suffix before resuming. A suffix failure is thrown back at that yield with `throw()`, where the stage can catch it and continue.
The same yield protocol, awaiting both suffix completion and error delivery before resuming.

blocks.text: The async runner still joins every started traversal. If a stage completes normally without ever observing a rejected next Promise, run rejects with that original failure. Several unobserved failures form an aggregate in start order with code `MULTIPLE_DOWNSTREAM_FAILED`. Calling `then` transfers responsibility for its resulting Promise chain to the caller; it does not itself report an error. Cancellation and host activity checks still apply.

Prints `1,2,3 true`. The stage handles the second traversal's failure, and the third still runs. Without a catch around `await next(2)`, JavaScript exits that stage and never executes its later `next(3)` statement.
A multiple generator catches a suffix failure at its own yield:

Prints `1,3 true`. Async-generator uses the same rule and awaits traversal and error delivery. An uncaught failure ends the stage and runs cleanup. An ordinary `return value` adds another traversal. `GENERATOR_CONTINUE`, `GENERATOR_HALT`, and ordinary `undefined` add none and do not undo completed traversals. `yield GENERATOR_UNDEFINED` explicitly submits undefined. A sync stage lifted into another mode still returns normally before traversing every registered value and aggregating failures.

sections.heading: Entry point, ownership and execution model

blocks.text: The module has one entry, `@migaia/middleware-pipeline`, and one runtime dependency, `@migaia/utils`. It depends on neither DOM nor Node nor a lifecycle host. The root exports `createPipeline()`, mode and generator-signal constants, public stage/control/context types, and error codes. Concrete executors and adapters are internal and cannot be imported from the root.

A pipeline contains only read-only `mode`, `lift()` and `run()`. Current values, indices, cancellation contexts and next-call state belong to each individual run. One pipeline can be reused, with runs isolated from one another. Every run copies the stage list: replacing, inserting or deleting entries in the caller's array afterwards does not change that run's function sequence.

A stage receives the current value and chooses whether to continue, stop or fail. The done callback is the terminal consumer after all stages continue successfully. The module stores no application state, owns no abort controller, and creates or closes no host. Lifecycle assertions reuse the host's existing generations, leases or scopes instead of rebuilding them here.

`createPipeline<TValue>(options)` requires an explicit mode. Its result, `IMiddlewarePipeline<TMode, TValue, TSignals>`, uses that mode to determine stages, done callbacks, run results and supported lifts. The public options type is `ICreatePipelineOptions<TMode>`.

rows: `'sync'`, `'async'`, `'generator'` or `'async-generator'`, exposed as `MiddlewarePipelineMode.sync`, `async`, `generator` and `asyncGenerator`. Fixed after creation.
`'single'` or `'multiple'`, also exposed by `MiddlewarePipelineNext`. Fixed for every stage and lift; multiple allows independent suffix traversals in all four modes.
Synchronously receives `'duplicate'` or `'late'`, also exposed as `MiddlewarePipelineViolation.duplicate` and `late`. Reports an invalid next call without restarting downstream.
A synchronous host lifecycle assertion, checked at entry and after each stage. Async downstream entry also checks it. A throw prevents continuation; the pipeline does not change host state.
Default cancellation signal for runs without their own signal. Signal shape and state are admitted when run starts, not during pipeline creation.
Three distinct generator-control symbols under `undefined`, `halt` and `continue`. The default set is frozen.
Continues with an explicit undefined payload rather than stopping.
Under single, stops the chain. Under multiple, adds no terminal traversal or rollback of earlier yields.
Under single, continues with the last yield or input. Under multiple, adds no terminal traversal.

Only for independent failures in an async stage and its started downstream. Receives the stage failure first, downstream failure second. Its return value is thrown as the combined failure. The caller must preserve both originals through cause or AggregateError.errors.

blocks.text: Construction options must be an object, never null or an array. Supported option fields and the three custom signal properties are read once, then retained in a frozen internal snapshot. Later mutation of the caller's object cannot change the pipeline. The read-only mode publishes that same validated value. Invalid modes, next policies, callbacks, controls, signal shapes, signal sets and lift directions produce a native `TypeError` with `INVALID_OPTION`. Original option-getter failures remain on `cause`.

sections.heading: run, next and the four modes

blocks.text: The common call is `pipeline.run(stages, value, done, control?)`.

rows: Read-only array of stages for this mode. An entry snapshot fixes function identities for the current run; later array edits affect later runs.
Caller-supplied initial payload. Each later stage receives the previous stage's committed value.
Receives the final value of each traversal that neither stopped nor failed. An empty stage array reaches done directly. Sync modes require a synchronous callback; async modes also accept a Promise.
Defaults to `undefined`. Currently has only optional `signal`; the object cannot be null or an array.
Defaults to `undefined`, falling back to construction signal. A supplied valid signal replaces the default rather than merging with it.
The signal actually selected for this run. With no signal, no additional context argument is passed.
Read-only mode for inspection or selecting matching stage types.

blocks.text: The following mode table describes the default single policy. Multiple behavior is described in independent submissions.

rows: After the stage returns normally; next only commits a value.
The first next call starts downstream immediately, enabling before/after wrapping.
After the generator finishes and its return value is interpreted.
After the async generator finishes and its return value is interpreted.

blocks.text: With the default `next: 'single'`, a synchronous stage commits at most one `next(value)`. Not calling next short-circuits the chain, skipping later stages and done. This is a linear transformation: synchronous code after next still runs before downstream. A throwing stage never starts downstream.

An asynchronous stage's accepted `next(value)` immediately starts downstream and returns a Promise for that traversal. Code after `await next(value)` wraps downstream completion. Even if the stage does not await a started next, the runner waits for downstream settlement before finishing. Normal completion without next also short-circuits.

With `next: 'single'`, `duplicate` means another next call before the stage completes; `late` means calling a captured next after completion. Neither overwrites the first committed value nor starts downstream again. The default handler ignores violations; use `onViolation` to report them. A callback throw inside run follows that mode's failure channel. A reporter throw triggered by calling captured next after run has ended is thrown directly from that next call.
With the default `next: 'single'`, a stage may yield several times, but intermediate values are not individually delivered downstream. Only its final return chooses the next value.

rows: Continues with the last yield, or the current input if there was no yield.
Stops the whole chain without done.
Also stops; it is not an explicit undefined payload.
Continues with undefined; `TValue` must include undefined.

blocks.text: Custom `signals` replace all three default symbol identities. Return symbols from that same set. A sync stage lifted into a generator also uses the target pipeline's halt/continue signals; control symbols are not passed to done as ordinary payloads.

`TSignals` on `IGeneratorMiddlewareStage`, `IAsyncGeneratorMiddlewareStage`, `IMiddlewarePipeline` and `IMiddlewarePipelineStage` separates control values from `TValue`. Custom-signal overloads do not widen a numeric payload into symbols. The default set retains precise unique-symbol types.

`pipeline.lift(stage, from)` takes an existing stage and its source mode, then returns a stage for the current pipeline. Only these lossless directions are supported. A same-mode lift returns the original function with the same `===` identity.
Async-to-async-generator and reverse lifts are unsupported. Both TypeScript and runtime reject unsupported directions; runtime throws an `INVALID_OPTION` TypeError.

Lifts reuse the existing adapters while preserving call counts, violation reporting, errors and next-Promise semantics. In particular, a lifted sync stage still completes its synchronous tail after next before downstream starts. If that stage throws, downstream never starts. Lifting does not turn existing linear sync logic into async onion behavior.

Use native AbortSignal or the structural `IAbortSignal` type from `@migaia/utils/promise`. This module no longer exports `IAbortSignal` from its root. A valid signal has boolean aborted and compatible addEventListener/removeEventListener methods, with optional reason. The pipeline reads cancellation checkpoints and owns no controller.

All modes check run entry, before each stage, after each stage returns and before done. Generator modes also check after each iteration. A started stage is not forcibly interrupted, and signal cancellation does not make the runner abandon a Promise it is awaiting. Stages should cooperate through their supplied `context.signal`.

If cancellation is observed at a generator yield boundary, the runner calls iterator.return() and drains yields produced during cleanup. Cleanup values never reach downstream. Async-generator cleanup is awaited before rejection. If both abort and cleanup fail, an `ABORT_CLEANUP_FAILED` AggregateError retains abort first and cleanup failure second.

Each returning outer async stage rechecks cancellation and host activity even when done has already run. A failed check cannot undo that done callback. An ordinary user failure remains primary over a cancellation observed afterwards. A host `assertActive` control failure is not mistaken for two independent business failures and combined twice.
`MIDDLEWARE_PIPELINE_SOURCE` is `'middleware.pipeline'`. `MiddlewarePipelineErrorCode` is the public error table.

rows: Unclassified stage, done, host assertion, violation-handler or combiner failure. Independent async stage/downstream failures become an AggregateError by default.
Several sync or lifted-sync traversals fail, or several async traversals reject without observation. `AggregateError.errors` retains originals in registration/start order.
Invalid options, mode, callback, signal/control, signal set or lift direction; a native TypeError, with cause when there is an original failure.
Cooperative cancellation: an attachable, unclassified Error reason receives this code; other original reasons remain on cause.
Abort and generator cleanup both fail, aggregated with abort first.

blocks.text: Native stage, done and `assertActive` Errors keep their object, type and stack when identity can be attached. Without a complete semantic source/code they receive `EXECUTION_FAILED`; complete external identities remain unchanged. Immutable errors and non-Error values remain on a wrapper's cause. Error abort reasons are likewise preserved when possible; strings, undefined and other reasons remain on an ordinary Error's cause, which need not be a native AbortError. If the reason getter throws, its thrown value is treated as the reason.

When an async stage and its runner-owned downstream fail independently (in multiple mode, only unobserved branch rejections remain runner-owned), the default `EXECUTION_FAILED` AggregateError.errors retain stage then downstream. Merely awaiting next and receiving the same object failure does not create two duplicate error entries. Equal primitive values can still represent independent failures and are not deduplicated by value.

A custom combiner's returned value becomes the propagated failure. The caller must keep both original failures reachable through cause or errors. If the combiner throws, its original failure stays primary where possible, with both preexisting failures attached to the errors/cause chain.

The root exports `MiddlewarePipelineNext`, `ICreatePipelineOptions`, `IMiddlewarePipeline`, `IMiddlewarePipelineStage`, `IMiddlewarePipelineDone`, `IMiddlewarePipelineRunResult`, `IMiddlewarePipelineLiftSource`, the four stage types, context/control types, violation types and signal types. Applications reach executors through `createPipeline`, run and lift.

`IMiddlewarePipelineSyncMode` is only an internal conditional-type helper for Done/RunResult. It was withdrawn from the root with no compatibility alias. Use public `IMiddlewarePipelineDone` and `IMiddlewarePipelineRunResult` instead.
